correctness.rationale: Cycle-divisibility map lemma from Konieczny and a direct phase bijection prove (1); equivariant retracts are exactly selections of fixed cycles with admissible targets. A divisor-poset lower bound and unique minimum selections prove (2). The action of S_n by conjugation on rooted set partitions and Burnside orbits proves (3) coefficientwise. All 66 cycle-type cases for 1<=n<=8 independently confirmed by exhaustive Python checks. Finite cases are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The all-cycle-type rank polynomial and exact divisibility-minimum fiber are quantitative refinements beyond the published cycle-mapping theorem; the rank-refined symmetric-group Burnside average links the complete family to integer partitions. The full mathematical statements were compared with accessible primary literature and searchable related research, including alternative equivariant-map terminology. An equivalent unpublished/older formula is a residual priority risk, not ruled out by negative searches.
residual_risks: The known 2003 cycle-divisibility lemma makes the enumerator derivable by direct counting; an earlier publication might already make that deduction explicitly.
Literature on retractions of finite cyclic G-sets, group actions, or endomorphism-monoid rank enumeration may contain equivalent formulas under different titles.
The complete 2024 publisher article could not be exhaustively inspected due to rate limiting, though its object is structurally distinct.
The full 2013 general-centralizer article was not inspected page-by-page.

The nontrivial divisibility-minimal skeleton and rank-refined partition/Burnside expectation connect semigroup structure, divisor posets and partition enumeration.
